title: Article / Log Frontmatter
description: Single source of truth for content/articles/**/*.md and content/logs/**/*.md frontmatter. Consumed by the Zed YAML LSP (Layer 1) and the git pre-commit hook validator at scripts/validate-frontmatter.js (Layer 2). Hugo's build-time partial (Layer 3) hardcodes the growth_stage enum independently — keep them in sync when adding values.

title.description: Page title. SEO meta title. 60–70 characters max.

slug.description: Optional URL slug override. Use when title contains umlauts (Ä, Ö, Ü, ß) or other special characters.

date.description: Publication date. Hugo accepts ISO 8601 strings or YAML timestamps; both are valid here. Type intentionally unconstrained so YAML auto-parsed dates (Date objects after gray-matter) don't trip the validator.

lastmod.description: Last-modification date. Override Hugo's git-based default. Type intentionally unconstrained (see `date`).

publishdate.description: Future publish date (only useful when running Hugo on a server). Type intentionally unconstrained (see `date`).

draft.description: true = excluded from production builds. Flip to false to publish.

weight.description: Sort weight. 1 makes the article sticky on the homepage; other numbers sort articles.

categories.description: Only the first entry is rendered as the category ribbon.

series.description: Use the same series name across articles to group them.

summary.description: Required for articles. Used as the list-view excerpt and SEO description fallback.

growth_stage.description: Digital-garden content maturity. seedling = early/draft, budding = developing, evergreen = mature/maintained, withered = deprecated. If omitted, templates fall back to seedling.

desc.description: SEO meta description. 120–158 characters. Falls back to summary if empty.

keywords.description: 1–3 keywords. Auto-derived from tags if empty.

canonicalURL.description: Use when the post is republished from another platform.
